statement: The reason why we do not yet match the running times of [31] is because the faster algorithms rely on light Euclidean spanners, while no light (Steiner) spanners exist for hyperbolic point sets as of yet. Are there Steiner spanners of lightness poly(1/ε) in Hd ?
context: In this paper we have obtained approximation schemes for d-dimensional hyperbolic TSP d−1 and hyperbolic Steiner tree with running time 2O(1/ε ) n poly(log n) (our approximation schemes follow from the structure theorem, mostly using standard techniques; we go into this in the full version [32]). Some interesting open questions remain for future work. The reason why we do not yet match the running times of [31] is because the faster algorithms rely on light Euclidean spanners, while no light (Steiner) spanners exist for hyperbolic point sets as of yet. Are there Steiner spanners of lightness poly(1/ε) in Hd ? What about light banyans? Is it possible to use the techniques of [40] to get a linear dependence on n?
